x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Generates a scannable QR code image for your WiFi network, saved as a PNG to the current directory

options.name: --name
options.description: The (name) of the WiFi network as it appears when scanning for networks

options.name: --password
options.description: The security protocol used by the network. WPA2 is recommended for most modern routers (default: WPA2)

options.name: --auth
options.description: Authentication type (WPA2, WPA, WEP, nopass) [default: WPA2]
